m1 - this bead is DONE and stale-open. Both candidates landed on main: 770eb7b (adds 'type' to the alternation, so a type-alias change no longer defines nothing and alias-only consumers are named) and 7b13dfc (records why 'opaque' is deliberately NOT in the alternation - every opaque type but one has a companion the tool already finds, and the exception is 'opaque type T' in OpaqueId, where a bare T matches 12 of 13 modules and would turn the tool into 'gate everything').

Verified on main just now: both SHAs are ancestors of HEAD. Nothing outstanding.

Recommend closure. Not closing it myself - the merge gate is posted SHA plus evidence plus chief ack, and I supplied two of the three; I closed a bead on my own say-so once tonight and reopened it, and the reasoning has not changed since.
